input.prompt:
Propose one experimentally testable VH/VL redesign for B7-H3 Arm A
parent 275, for a Y-shaped humanized IgG with separate HC and LC.
Use only the reference evidence below at its stated strength. Preserve the arm's
intended epitope and complete variable-domain framework. Treat reference-chain
and internal-coverage uncertainties explicitly. If evidence is insufficient for
a warranted sequence change, return a review_required result with the reason.
Return JSON with parent_id, arm, status, vh, vl, changes, rationale and uncertainties.
Do not use tools or read other files. The final Fc and pairing architecture are
outside this proposal. Do not represent predicted binding as measured.
Use the verified RFantibody design-loop positions to distinguish design loops
from framework. The AF3 contacts are model observations. Propose at most two
loop substitutions as hypotheses when supported by the parent evidence, with
explicit residue-level rationale. Preserve framework residues and sequence
lengths. If the input poses are insufficient, record why.

proposal.rationale: The returned VH and VL are the parent sequences, preserving all framework residues and both chain lengths. VH S104 is in the verified RFantibody H3 design loop and is the only antibody residue reported to contact the same target position, canonical 129, in both contact-positive AF3 samples (4.21 and 2.81 Å). These distances support inspecting S104, but the supplied observations give no side-chain interaction or substitution-specific rationale for changing it. The modeled contacts to R127 shift from VL G92/G93 in L3 to VL D28 in L1. The reference evidence supports retaining the IgV1 FG loop as the intended epitope and provides no residue-level basis for a substitution in parent 275.
uncertainties: Two of four AF3 samples have empty contact lists at the 4.5 Å cutoff. The contact record does not establish whether their poses miss the FG loop or whether internal target or interface coverage is incomplete. Atom-level geometry and confidence are also unavailable, so the two contact-positive samples do not establish a reproducible pose or measured binding.

The 8H9 patent reports 34.8 nM binding to 4Ig for both H1L2 and H2L1. Full mature variable-domain coverage and the exact reference pair to use remain unverified. The experimental ch8H9 structure is of the Fab alone, and FG-loop binding evidence applies at the lineage level.

The 8H8 parental mapping implicates R127, but the disclosed mouse VH/VL pair does not verify the chains of the tested humanized variants. The canonical overlap of the T3CL11 co-crystal epitope with Arm A remains unresolved.
